slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers review, citing the 2024 National Health Sector Strategic Plan, says 71% of health facilities have CMIS, with a target of 95% by 2028, and that the 29% without it may still be partly on paper; the share is of all health facilities and no numerator or denominator is given.
The Data Landscapers review says the National Health Sector Strategic Plan 2024-28 reports CMIS coverage and sets a target of 95% of health facilities by 2028.
The Data Landscapers review says CMIS supports point-of-care data entry for clinical management, with tablet job aids linked to it at primary level (no date stated for this, published date used).

The Data Landscapers review says rural primary healthcare clinics predominantly record patient data digitally in CMIS and that it found no evidence of entirely paper-based rural clinics; it does not describe other tiers (no date stated, published date used).

systems.tiers: 71% of health facilities as of the 2024 NHSSP, including rural primary healthcare clinics
Rural Health Motivators at community level; piloted in one region in 2026, integrating with CMIS
